method.name: SetMaterial
method.description: Material has no effect for text label.

method.name: SetOrientation3D
method.description: Setup label orientation in the model 3D space.

method.name: UnsetOrientation3D
method.description: Reset label orientation in the model 3D space.

method.name: FontName
method.description: Returns the font of the label text.

method.name: FontAspect
method.description: Returns the font aspect of the label text.

method.name: Orientation3D
method.description: Returns label orientation in the model 3D space.

method.name: HasOrientation3D
method.description: Returns true if the current text placement mode uses text orientation in the model 3D space.

method.name: SetOwnAnchorPoint
method.description: Set flag if text uses position as point of attach

method.name: SetDisplayType
method.description: Define the display type of the text.

method.name: SetColorSubTitle
method.description: Modifies the colour of the subtitle for the TODT_SUBTITLE TextDisplayType and the colour of backgroubd for the TODT_DEKALE TextDisplayType.

method.name: TextFormatter
method.description: Returns text presentation formatter; NULL by default, which means standard text formatter will be used.

method.name: SetTextFormatter
method.description: Setup text formatter for presentation. It's empty by default.
